Name: Affordable Workforce Housing
H1 Header Text: Method Homes builds multi-unit workforce housing that is affordable, accessible, and efficient.
Paragraph Description: Our off-site construction process allows us to build units efficiently to provide much needed housing as quickly as possible, with consistent quality among all of the units. On these affordable housing projects, Method Homes often partners with local nonprofit organizations committed to affordable housing and community impact. Our affordable housing initiatives have served essential workers, low-income families, people experiencing homelessness, disabled people, and other underserved populations.
Section 1 Description: Our off-site construction process allows us to complete site prep concurrently with module fabrication, leading to a much quicker construction timeline.
Section 2 Description: Since we build the modules in our state-of-the-art, climate-controlled factory, we can maintain consistently high quality in each unit.
Section 3 Description: We often partner with local nonprofits to complete affordable and workforce housing projects, ensuring each unit is designed specifically around the needs of the community it is serving.

Name: Classrooms and School Additions
H1 Header Text: Method Homes has completed a variety of school expansion and classroom projects.
